title: Induction of zinc conjugated with Doxorubicin for the prevention of aggregating beta-catenin in the Wnt signaling pathway investigated through computational approaches.
authors: Rajagopal, Gomathi; Ramachandran, Balajee; Deivanayagam, Paradesi; Srinivasadesikan, Venkatesan; Pandi, Boomi; Muthupandian, Saravanan; Sundarraj, Rajamanikandan; Gebru, Goyitom Gebremedhn
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接、MD和DFT研究Zn-阿霉素复合物对β-catenin/Tcf-4复合物的破坏作用，属于蛋白质-DNA互作（Tcf-4为DNA结合转录因子）的广义体系，但核心是药物-蛋白结合而非TF-DNA结合位点或互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Canonical Wnt signaling plays a key role in tumor cell proliferation which correlates with the accumulation of beta-catenin resulting inactivation of the network of targets such as GSK3beta, Axin, CK1. Uncontrolled expression of beta-catenin leads to different types of cancers and other diseases such as sarcoma and mesenchymal tumor formation. However, beta-catenin is an attractive target for cervical cancer. In the present study, the compounds such as Doxorubicin and Zinc conjugated with Doxorubicin were screened against beta-catenin using Molecular Docking, Molecular Dynamics Simulation, MM/GBSA, and DFT approaches to explore their insights. The study further demonstrated that the binding energy of Zn conjugated with Doxorubicin has shown -7.2 kcal/mol and Doxorubicin registers -5.9 kcal/mol against beta-catenin. The disruption between the beta-catenin/Tcf-4 complex was observed through the Zinc-Doxorubicin complex, both the proteins are separated about 12 A. The Zn-Doxorubicin was stabilized with the hydrophobic residues such as Val349 of beta-catenin and Phe21 of Tcf-4. The DFT analysis using the B3LYP/6-31g(d,p) method explores that Zn-doxorubicin in complex with the binding site residues has shown the HOMO-LUMO gap of 2.55 eV. The binding free energy calculations exhibit the Zn conjugated Doxorubicin favors in the study by showing ~ 3 kcal/mol difference with Doxorubicin. The Zn-conjugated Doxorubicin will be discussed in the context of cervical cancer with the hope of improving drug efficacy and reducing toxicities for the betterment of the patient's quality of life.
abstract_zh: 经典Wnt信号传导在肿瘤细胞增殖中发挥关键作用，这与β-连环蛋白（beta-catenin）的积累相关，导致GSK3beta、Axin、CK1等靶标网络失活。β-连环蛋白的失控表达会导致不同类型的癌症及其他疾病，如肉瘤和间充质肿瘤的形成。然而，β-连环蛋白是宫颈癌的一个有吸引力的靶点。在本研究中，使用分子对接 (molecular docking)、分子动力学模拟 (molecular dynamics simulation)、MM/GBSA和DFT方法，对阿霉素（Doxorubicin）及锌结合阿霉素等化合物针对β-连环蛋白进行筛选，以探索其见解。研究进一步表明，锌结合阿霉素对β-连环蛋白的结合能为-7.2 kcal/mol，而阿霉素则为-5.9 kcal/mol。通过锌-阿霉素复合物观察到β-连环蛋白/Tcf-4复合物的解离，两种蛋白质分离约12 Å。锌-阿霉素通过疏水残基如β-连环蛋白的Val349和Tcf-4的Phe21得以稳定。使用B3LYP/6-31g(d,p)方法的DFT分析表明，锌-阿霉素与结合位点残基的复合物显示出HOMO-LUMO能隙为2.55 eV。结合自由能计算显示，锌结合阿霉素在研究中表现出优势，与阿霉素相比差异约3 kcal/mol。锌结合阿霉素将在宫颈癌背景下进行讨论，以期提高药物疗效并减少毒性，从而改善患者的生活质量。
